improvements.rationale: A well-crafted meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly communicating the value proposition. Open Graph and Twitter Card tags ensure the homepage displays professionally when shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, and Twitter—critical channels for reaching business owners and traders. The copy highlights key differentiators (Claude-powered, voice chat, free trial) without overpromising, building trust with the target audience.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Partner"

Subheading: "Meet Gideon — the intelligent assistant built for business owners, traders, and professionals. Get instant answers, voice chat, and expert support. Try 3 free searches now."
improvements.rationale: The headline positions Gideon as a collaborative partner rather than just a tool, building trust and perceived value. The subheading clearly identifies the target audience (business owners, traders, professionals), highlights three key features (instant answers, voice chat, expert support), and includes a clear, low-friction CTA with the specific free trial offer. This creates immediate clarity on what Gideon does and why visitors should engage.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to choose a membership plan to continue. Plans start from just US$2 per day, billed monthly or annually—with annual billing saving you 30 percent. As a member, you'll unlock unlimited access to Gideon's workspace, voice chat, and professional trade and business support.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in a freemium model—what happens when the trial ends. By clearly explaining the transition and reinforcing the low entry price and value, it reduces uncertainty and encourages conversion at the paywall moment.
